column1: NOTICE CALLING FOR CLAIMS TO LAND PARCELS
Registration  of  Title Act, No.  21 of  1998
It is hereby notified that any person having a claim to the ownership or possession or interest to one or more of the parcels of lands re-
flected in the Cadastral Map No. 420385  made by the Surveyor-General under Section 11 of the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of
1998 relating to the village of Henemulla (Division of No. 06, Wehera) Kurunegala Municipal Council (Block 03) or any part thereof,
situated within the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 841 - Kurunegala Town South in the Divisional Secretariat Division of Kurunegala
in the District of Kurunegala in the Province of North Western should submit his claim to the undersigned before 26th December, 2019
In the event of failure to submit any claim before the above-mentioned date, action will be taken to hold an exparte inquiry to determine
title to the land and accordingly publish such determination in the Government Gazette in terms of Section 14 of the above Act.
